technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present potential bounce setup, but pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative CMF, MACD histogram negative) and lack of bullish confirmation signals make this a low-probability entry with significant downside risk.

fundamental.summary: WELL shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 48 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market sentiment presents contrarian opportunity; moderate congressional buying by Ro Khanna (two purchases in June) supports cautious bullish bias despite lack of recent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295), FOMC event in 1 day creates binary event risk, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment; earnings in 48 days adds moderate uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period), supertrend bullish signal, and contrarian sentiment opportunity with congressional buying conviction create a potential mean-reversion bounce setup near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative CMF/MACD, no bullish crossovers), macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 295, FOMC binary event in 1 day), and zero fundamental conviction make this a low-probability entry with asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold and supertrend bullish create technical bounce potential, but pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative CMF/MACD) and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 295, FOMC binary event tomorrow) create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs mean-reversion opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 1 day combined with inverted yield curve and real estate sector credit stress creates binary macro event risk that could trigger further capitulation below current support levels.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 8 positions in Real Estate sector; adding WELL increases concentration risk in macro-vulnerable sector during crisis VIX environment.
